owner_policy.quote: nothing should be paid … cut the probes and make them free.
owner_policy.scope: This repo's own automation: anything a workflow, a script or an agent in this repository runs. The Time2Read product's own inference is a separate named lane below, funded by subscriptions, and is not governed by max_cost_usd.

policy.on_reported_cost: throw PaidCostError and fail the run

pricing_snapshot.selection: strongest general instruct models among the $0 list, largest context first. Excluded: google/lyria-3-* (music, and not :free so it can turn paid silently), nvidia/nemotron-3.5-content-safety:free (safety classifier), poolside/laguna-* and cohere/north-mini-code:free (code-only), liquid/lfm-2.5-2.6b:free (sub-10B), openrouter/free (non-deterministic meta-router), nvidia/nemotron-3-super-120b-a12b:free (listed but 404 on every call, 26 Oct 2026), and thinkingmachines/inkling*:free (403 "only available on agentic harnesses" on a sibling repo's first live dispatch, 11 Oct 2026).

automation_lane.detail: No script or workflow in this repository calls a model. The Search Console collectors, the prerender check and the IndexNow submitter are all deterministic. The router exists so that the first one to need a model has a $0 door to go through instead of naming its own.
